plots.brief: Westernmost town house, about 11x10 walls on an 18x22 plot, four storeys of pale stone on a chiselled plinth, door north onto the south ring under a carved stone door case. Symmetrical facade with tall mullioned windows, copper gutters and a deepslate roof. The south side steps down through a small walled back garden to a terrace looking over the river where it leaves the city; one detail: an oxidised copper oriel at the river corner.

Town house about 11x10 walls on an 18x22 plot, three to four storeys, door north onto the south ring, stone door case with spruce door and blue banner. Ordered symmetrical facade with stone mullions, copper gutters, deepslate tile roof with twin chimneys. Walled back garden to the south with a fruit tree and a gate; one detail: a copper-roofed bay over the door.

Fine town house about 11x10 walls on a 23x13 plot, four storeys, door east onto the King's Way with a carved stone door case and steps up from the avenue. Calcite and diorite facade with smooth-stone quoins, tall mullioned windows, copper gutters, dark deepslate roof; small walled garden behind to the west toward the river. One detail: a copper-capped corner turret facing the south ring.

Fine town house about 11x10 walls on a 23x12 plot, three to four storeys, door east onto the King's Way matching its northern neighbour in symmetry but with a bow window above the door. Pale stone on a cut-stone plinth, copper gutters, deepslate roof, walled back garden to the west. One detail: a blue banner pair and wall lanterns flanking the door case.
